query_support.causal_light: observational under a structural exclusion prior
query_support.stability_filtered: observational prediction plus structural exclusions, stability audits, and stratum-conditioned action-success tables
query_support.structural_causal: observational prediction plus latent-state interventional value estimation

meta.counterfactual_note: No headline benchmark result should be interpreted as a counterfactual query. The structural-causal agent estimates interventional action values over a latent-state model, but no agent performs individual-level abduction.
meta.confidence_interval: 95% Student-t CI on n=12 seed means
meta.significance_test: paired exact sign-flip permutation test over matched seeds
meta.effect_size: Cohen's dz over paired seed deltas
meta.primary_estimand: matched-seed drop in success_rate from normal to adversarial with agent state carried across the full three-phase trajectory
meta.phase_protocol_note: Headline protocol carries agent state from normal through surface_shift to adversarial, so phase comparisons estimate within-trajectory adaptation under shift.

negative_result.summary: Structural Causal does not dominate Stability-Filtered in missing data bias; Stability-Filtered is stronger on raw utility, robustness.
